name: Visible Block Face Meshing
aliases: Chunk-based Voxel Meshing with Neighbor Awareness
Voxel Face Culling (Greedy Meshing-lite / Immediate Mode Culling)
Voxel Face Culling (Greedy Meshing-lite / Immediate Mode Culling), Voxel Face Visibility Culling, mesh_chunk_visible_block_faces
definition: A mesh generation technique that creates geometry consisting only of block faces that are visible (i.e., adjacent to air or transparent blocks), without merging adjacent faces into larger quads.
